name: Investment Account Modification 4
definition: Information about the modification of an account.

ModificationReason.name: Modification Reason
ModificationReason.definition: Reason for the modification to the investment account information.

AccountApplicationIdentification.name: Account Application Identification
AccountApplicationIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier of the account modification request.

ClientReference.name: Client Reference
ClientReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous investor's identification of a transfer.

CounterpartyReference.name: Counterparty Reference
CounterpartyReference.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction, for example, a transfer, as allocated by the counterparty.

ExistingAccountIdentification.name: Existing Account Identification
ExistingAccountIdentification.definition: Account to which the account opening is related.

InstructionDetailsElementRule.definition: One of the elements (ModificationReason, AccountApplicationIdentification, ClientReference, CounterpartyReference, ExistingAccountIdentification) must be present.
